sections.intent: One solo cello strand: first wooden tap, baby grip resolves tonic
Childhood pizzicato, short notes on kite bends
Legato cello follows bicycle then red lovers; highest note on first nose touch
House and eyelid descend into held note
Music zero including tails, held ink nib. Narrator and barely audible ink bloom remain
Solo resumes, slower fragile bow for trembling jaw. Last three eyelash notes then held whole portrait
Portrait breath and handoff, no layered pad
One hand chime then child pizzicato; speed-driven lighter pen and natural final decay

provenance: Fresh independent cello melody and nib-derived scratch events, preserving published solo-instrument architecture and stop/handoff cues. No source master audio reused.
